mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.book_id AS bookId, b.title AS bookTitle, r.amount, r.type AS typeCode, CASE r.type WHEN 1 THEN '仅退款' WHEN 2 THEN '退货退款' END AS typeName, r.reason, r.status AS statusCode, CASE r.status WHEN 1 THEN '待处理' WHEN 2 THEN '同意' WHEN 3 THEN '拒绝' WHEN 4 THEN '已完成' END AS statusName, r.applicant_id AS applicantId, COALESCE(ap.nickname, au.username) AS applicantName, r.handler_id AS handlerId, COALESCE(hp.nickname, hu.username) AS handlerName, r.handle_result AS handleResult, r.create_time, r.update_time FROM refund r JOIN trade_order o ON r.order_id = o.id AND o.deleted = 0 JOIN book b ON o.book_id = b.id AND b.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user au ON r.applicant_id = au.id AND au.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_profile ap ON au.id = ap.user_id AND ap.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user hu ON r.handler_id = hu.id AND hu.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_profile hp ON hu.id = hp.user_id AND hp.deleted = 0 WHERE 1 = 1
